# Learn the story of Manuel Montoya, a physics engineer and athlete

**Manuel Montoya is a graduate of our undergraduate program in Physics Engineering and our master's program in Data Science and Analytics. He was also born in a tennis club, as he himself says, and today he is an established athlete in this sport. We talked to him about his career in tennis, how he has combined the sport with his academic and professional life, and about one of his dreams come true: representing Colombia and #EAFIT this year at the World University Games in China. Here's what he told us!**

###### EAFIT is the top university in Antioquia and the second in Colombia in terms of reputation, according to Merco Empresas 2026.

EAFIT is the university with the best corporate reputation in Antioquia and the second in Colombia.
